caption: A lit three-arm chandelier with frosted white glass shades hangs from a metal ceiling canopy by a short chain, suspended above an interior room corner. The walls wear mauve wallpaper patterned with pale leaf lines, and a small framed portrait is mounted on the wall behind the fixture. The top edge of a wooden door sits at lower left while a dark wooden cabinet stands at right. The camera drifts slowly, carrying the portrait, the door, the cabinet and the ceiling line steadily toward the right and downward across the frame. As this sweep continues, a framed photo collage on the left wall slides into view at the frame's edge. The chandelier's shades change apparent orientation relative to the canopy as the viewpoint shifts, while its three bulbs stay illuminated throughout. No person or other moving object enters the scene.
